target_definition: India CPI Combined General Group inflation, year-over-year percent; official MoSPI 2024-base back/current files; missing 2025 YoY derived from same-base index levels.
test_period_definition: Rolling-origin comparison period, forecast targets >= 2024-01; baseline and expanded feature specifications were compared on this same period, so it is not an untouched final production holdout.
development_period_definition: Forecast target months < 2024-01; used for ensemble weights and empirical interval calibration.

data_quality.data_vintage_warning: No historical release-vintage snapshots; training uses retrieved/revised observations.

known_limitations: Only 153 monthly official 2024-base YoY targets through 2026-09; 2025 YoY is derived from same-base rounded index values.
No historical real-time release vintages; backtests use revised observed values and may overstate what was known at each origin.
The >=2024 comparison period was inspected to compare feature specifications and is not an independent final blind test.
Forecast origins overlap and are correlated; test sample is modest, especially by regime.
Forecast intervals are empirical calibration, not guaranteed coverage.
No claim of production readiness without external prospective monitoring, point-in-time data, and retraining governance.
